review.posthog_relevance: Adds permission mode parameters to warm task execution and its configuration, potentially affecting the behavior of the warm task execution workflow.
review.reason: The observed changes add a `permissionMode` parameter to the warm task execution and its associated configuration options. This could allow PostHog to control or distinguish warm task behavior based on permission settings. However, the implementation of the permission mode selection and its actual effect on the warm task is not shown, so the benefit is not established.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation and benefit of the permission mode selection are not shown, so the tier is conservative.
